notes.title: Scenes from ÁRIDA 2 revealed
notes.content:
During [url=https://latam.gamescom.global/pt/]Gamescom Latam[/url], the highly anticipated Brazilian game ÁRIDA 2: Rise of The Brave was highlighted in the Omelete Games Direct, an exclusive window of trailers and announcements with the latest news about the most anticipated Brazilian games by the public and critics!

With the global launch of the “First Look Teaser”, some new features of ÁRIDA 2 were revealed, including improvements in the visual aspect, with scenes during the day and at night, the introduction of the protagonists Cícera and her companion Titela, as well as a more dramatic tone in the narrative.

[previewyoutube=Kv5uVl5Ls4I;full][/previewyoutube]

The game will initially be released for PC, so the next stop for ÁRIDA 2 is the Steam Next Fest that will take place next June, when titles in development share details about the current state of development.

Add it to your wishlist, share with your friends and follow the ÁRIDA 2 page on Steam for more news!

notes.title: ÁRIDA on consoles!
notes.content:
The game about the culture of the Brazilian backlands completes its multiplatform saga! Switch and Xbox versions of the acclaimed [b]ÁRIDA: Backland’s Awakening[/b] will be available starting [b]November 22[/b]!

The end of the year brought great news for [b]Aoca Game Lab[/b]. After winning second place in the "Embratur - Brasil Tá pra Game!" award, ÁRIDA finally arrives on consoles, establishing the series’ two feet in the multiplatform world.

The first version was released for [b]PCs in 2019[/b], followed by updates in 2020, with the “[b]1 Year Edition[/b]”, and 2021, with the “[b]2 Year Edition”[/b], versions that brought new content, languages ​​and improvements to the game inspired by the historic town of [b]Canudos[/b]. In 2022, the mobile versions (Android and iOS) were released, followed by a major update in 2023 with the “[b]Definitive Edition[/b]” version, which brought [b]ÁRIDA[/b] to the [b]Google Play Pass[/b] subscription system.

Now, at the end of [b]2024[/b], [b]Cícera’s adventures[/b] will find new fans in the world of consoles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33252395/8df0a36d8d05b36f4b6ed06939be86ccb5bcd738.jpg[/img]

According to the company’s [b]COO, Victor Cardozo[/b], completing this journey is part of the series’ expansion plans, because, according to him: “[i]people have always asked for the console version. Especially on the Switch, where there is a great “match” with the players’ profile. This expansion could have come much earlier, but this escalation was part of our strategy[/i]”.

Despite the proposals from publishers and porting companies, Aoca made a bold decision: to overcome the difficulties involved in importing equipment and the development itself to take on the entire process to develop an internal porting core.

Regarding this, [b]Anderson Sampaio, the company's CTO[/b], states that "[i]it was a major challenge to carry out the port in parallel with the company's other projects. The programming and quality control teams have evolved a lot, so we are much better prepared for the future challenges of the series. This is a great achievement that is still celebrated internally today, as we now have the autonomy and decision-making power to take our series to the main platforms: PC, Mobile and Consoles[/i]".

Taking advantage of the momentum, [b]Aoca[/b] is also preparing to launch the Epic Store version of [b]ÁRIDA[/b], seeking to further expand the reach of the series in the PC world. The Playstation version is also being developed "in-house", with a release scheduled for the first half of 2025.

But the news doesn't stop there!

Later this year, ÁRIDA will receive an update for [b]3 new languages: Polish, Vietnamese and Indonesian[/b], recurring demands especially for the mobile version, meaning that internationalization strategies can count on [b]15 languages[/b] ​​instead of 12.

notes.title: ÁRIDA: Definitive Edition
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/franchise/arida][b]ÁRIDA[/b][/url] gets a [b]Definitive version[/b] that promises to please new and old fans of the series. 🌵

Improvements were implemented to expand and improve the experience, such as [b]a map, new missions, new items, collectibles, and even new mechanics![/b]

There are also three new game modes: “[b]Adventurer[/b]” and “[b]Survivor[/b]” and “[b]Fearless[/b]”. In the first, dedicated to people who like to explore the scenarios and interact with the story, it is possible to have a more relaxing experience. Unlike the second, where the drought is more merciless and brings a more challenging experience. The third level is only recommended for more experienced profiles in survival games.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33252395/7e14b98687381ccdaf91a4e53584698011c7b64b.png[/img]

There are more than 100 pages dedicated to behind the scenes at Aoca, with concepts, research and lots of fun facts about the creation of ARIDA 1, as well as exclusive details of our next game, [url=store.steampowered.com/app/1212030/ARIDA_2_Rise_of_the_Brave][b]ARIDA 2: Rise of the Brave[/b][/url]!

notes.content:
Who played [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/907760/ARIDA_Backlands_Awakening]ÁRIDA: Backland's Awakening[/url][/b] experienced a little of the importance of the [b]banners [/b]in [b]Cícera's journey[/b].

[b]Banners [/b]are symbols used in many contexts, almost always as allegories of beauty, guidance, and devotion. Critically embroidered or made in a stripped-down manner with a piece of cloth, they hold the history and identity of a group of people.

[previewyoutube=6Az9Ljtusfo;full][/previewyoutube]

In [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1212030/ARIDA_Rise_of_the_Brave/]ÁRIDA: Rise of the Brave [/url][/b]we will apply new visual techniques that will give more life to these elements, which will also have other symbols and other colors.

When you are in the company of [b]Cícera [/b]and [b]Titela [/b]inside the backlands, do not ignore the presence of the banners. They say more than our eyes can see.

notes.title: Dev Blog: The Goats from the Village
notes.content:
The goat is the main animal of the backlands. On Trip to backlands / Make of Firmina’s goats, we talked about Firmina’s ones. Now, throughout this text we will talk about the village goats, which are not assigned to a quest,  enriching the ambiance of the game and call attention when seen, always roaming the world. 😄
 
During the process of creating the Village level, we had the feeling that there was some aesthetic gap in that space. Somehow, it was necessary to think about elements (sound, visual or even compositional), which could give a balance between keeping the narrative proposal of the place aligned, while still giving more life and ambience to the level.
 
The presence of goats circulating around the village grew in this process. We started to use more of their movements, positions, and characteristics, exploring the possibilities of artificial intelligence in a slightly more autonomous way, also allowing a comical side of these formidable animals (which we could verify in some goats we found during our research trip to the backlands).
 
It is quite possible that when the player is exploring the village, suddenly: "Oops!", a goat appears performing its daily activities. And in this moment of unpredictability, our goats resemble the real backlands goats. 🐐

And that is why we love them, as well as many people who play Árida.

Árida is now available on Steam!
Go get your copy and share with us your experience with the goats. But be aware that they may appear in the most unlikely places!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33252395/9738ffa3308f0ecc6bc0921c6985614b634667db.png[/img]

[b]Hey everyone. We present to you our first patch after the game launch![/b]

The update contains some improvements that will upgrade the gameplay experience, especially in the mountain area, that seemed to be a major obstacle for you. Also, we made some balance changes and minor changes.

[b]Let's go![/b]
[h1]Game Balance[/h1]
[i]We increased the game difficulty, now you have to collect more food to stay healthy and you will get hungry and thirsty more often. It was too easy, right?[/i]

[b][list]
[*]Reduced the benefits of many aliments (Eggs, Mandacaru, etc).
[*]Increced the speed of reduction of the stats
[*]Now the Death Valley is aridity level 3 (from 4).
[/b]


[h1]Environment[/h1]
[i]We added more interaction objects, we hope you explore a lot. During your gameplay, some have complained about “invisible walls,” so we worked on the game's collisions responsible for these limits.[/i]

[b][list]
[*](Collider) Village area- Broken Bracket.
[*](Collider) Death Valley area - Dead Cow.
[*](Collider) Death Valley area - Invisible stones.
[*](Collider) Death Valley area - Fence Near the Cashew Tree.
[*](Collider) Farm Region - Bullock Cart.
[*](Terrain) Objects “buried” in certain parts of the map.
[*](Terrain) Objects “floating” in certain parts of the map.
[*](Terrain) Hole in the ground of the secret area.
[*](Terrain) Firmina's house area- Hole in the ground (Blue line).
[*](Terrain) Mountain area - Bannera.
[*](Terrain) Farm area - Woods floating in the corral.
[*](Models) Tiao doesn't disappear with distance anymore.
[*](Models) Mandacaru and other collectible foods disappear after being cut.
[*](Models) Trap's visual effect has been fixed.
[/b]


[h1]Narrative[/h1]
[i]Dialogues play an important role within the game and we saw that you love playing the "voices" of each character. We reviewed some texts that were displayed wrong.[/i]

[b][list]
[*](Objects) - Fixed the dialog on some objects.
[*](Interface) - Now the credits are displayed also in English
[*](Interface) - Texts some texts appearing in the wrong place
[/b]


[h1]Bugs and improvements[/h1]
[i]In the previous version, we saw several players encountering problems that discouraged you on your adventures. The bench at the end of the mountain was a major one, also the inventory that got stuck sometimes, not allowing the game to continue. We apologize for all the problems that have happened.[/i]

[b][list]
[*]Revised disappearance time of collected objects.
[*]Fixed the bug of the equipments stuck in Cicera's hand, after interaction with an object.
[*](Items) - Fixed a Confusing Notification 
[*](Feature) - All bench now work properly
[*](Feature) - Fixed the Inventory freezing when closed
[*](Feature) - Now the achievements don't disappear after game restart
[*](Feature) - Achievements are now accounted properly for by Steam
[/b]


[h1]Audio[/h1]
[i]In the audio sector, some changes have arrived, one of them being the addition of a component responsible for the individual configuration of each object within the game.[/h1]

[b][list]
[*](Feature) - Created audio tuning component
[*](Effect) - Individual audio adjustment of in-game objects
[*](Effect) - Fixed mountain ambient sound
[*](Effect) - Improved the ambient Sound of the Village
[*](Music) - Revised the audio from the last cutscene
[*](Extra) - Fixed the extra content audio after the end 
[/b]


We are following your comments on social networks, especially here on Steam. Feedbacks will always be welcome and followed thoroughly.

After checking the changes in-game, send us a review on Steam!

Meet us at the [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/VHndhdx]Discord[/url].

notes.content:
In this patch we improved the game performace, changed many dialogs and improved Almira storyline.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33252395/78f2f5819d43e704d24c72f6569f53b807a0280f.gif[/img]

[h1]Engine[/h1]
-- We updated the game engine, improving performance in many computers. We also improved the lighting and shadow effects.

[h1]Story and Characters[/h1]
- All characters have new dialogues!
- Firmina got a new goat! Find it at the way to the village.
- Almira is beautiful with her new clothes! She also has a new quest for you.
- We changed many texts for better understanding.

[h1]Environment[/h1]
- There is an old farm by the road with many new objects to be discovered.
- The village is bigger and better (but still not accessible) than before.

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
- Be very cautious when exploring new areas, because hunger and thirst drain faster!
- Some areas are more arid than others. Pay attention to the HUD!
- New recipe: obtained in Almira's quest

[h1]Art and Design[/h1]
- HUD improvements: new aridity indicator.
- Firmina and Almira have new animations.
- New textures in some buildings.

[h1]Controls[/h1]
- We are testing some improvements for those who play with mouse and keyboard.

[h1]Bug fixes and improvements[/h1]
- Now the signs show the text correctly.
- Corrected some of the descriptions.
- We improved the interaction range of ​​Cicera.
- We improved the collision with the waterhole. We also improved the collision with other problematic objects.
